title: Graph Valid Tree Check

monster.name: Arboreal Arbiter
monster.title: Judge of Acyclic Spanning Trees
monster.defeatQuote: Exactly n - 1 edges and single connected component validated!

description: Given `n` nodes labeled from `0` to `n - 1` and a list of undirected `edges`, determine if these edges form a valid tree. (A valid tree has exactly `n - 1` edges and is fully connected with no cycles).
starterCode:
def validTree(n: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> bool:
    pass
solutionCode:
def validTree(n: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> bool:
    if len(edges) != n - 1: return False
    parent = list(range(n))
    def find(i):
        if parent[i] == i: return i
        parent[i] = find(parent[i])
        return parent[i]
    for u, v in edges:
        root_u = find(u)
        root_v = find(v)
        if root_u == root_v: return False
        parent[root_u] = root_v
    return True
hints: A graph of n nodes is a tree if and only if it has n - 1 edges and no cycles.
